components.name: Card
components.doc: A card with an optional title that holds one child.

components.name: Badge
components.doc: A small pill showing a count or a status.

components.name: Callout
components.doc: A message banner: information, success, warning or error.

components.name: IconButton
components.doc: A round button showing only an icon.

components.name: RadioButton
components.doc: An option button: only one option of a group can be selected.

components.name: Option
components.doc: An item of a Dropdown or ComboBox list.

components.name: Dropdown
components.doc: A drop-down list for choosing one option. Add the options as Option children.

components.name: TabItem
components.doc: A page of a Tabs control.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A set of pages shown one at a time, with tabs. Add the pages as TabItem children.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.doc: A menu shown when a control that names it in its ContextMenu property is right-clicked, when a button names it in its DropDownMenu property, or from code (show). Add its commands as MenuItem elements; MenuItem children make a sub-menu.

components.name: MenuItem
components.doc: A command of a menu. MenuItem children make it a sub-menu; a Text of a single dash (or Kind Separator) makes a separator line.
